basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Jodhpur Research Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Community Medicine and Family Medicine, AIIMS Jodhpur, has invited applications for one Research Assistant post in the National AIDS Control Organization-funded project "Integrated Bio-Behavioral Surveillance among High Risk Group (HRG) and Clients of FSW", on a purely temporary basis up to 31.03.2027 with a consolidated pay of Rs. 31,000 per month. The essential qualification is a Master's in public health, Sociology, Social work, Anthropology, Microbiology, Zoology or Health Science (or equivalent), or a graduate degree in the same fields with three years of work experience

how_to_apply: Fill in the "Format for Application" printed on page 3 of the notice, which asks for the post name, advertisement file number and date, personal details, qualifications from High School onwards and post-qualification experience.
Sign the declaration and list the enclosures attached.
Email the scanned copy of the duly filled form to [email protected].
Send it on or before 13 November 2026 (Friday) by 1 pm.
The notice states that no enquiries will be entertained after the due date. The notice does not name a subject line for the email.
important_instructions: The post is purely temporary, co-terminus with the project; the candidate has no right to claim permanent employment under AIIMS Jodhpur or continuation in any other project. The contract service does not confer any right to further assignment or regular appointment in the institute. Persons working in Govt. or Public Sector undertaking must produce a No Objection Certificate at the time of interview. No TA/DA is admissible to appear in the interview. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.

content_sections.heading: About the Project
content_sections.text: The post is in an Extramural Research Project titled "HIV Surveillance and Epidemiology activities under the National AIDS Control Programme (NACP)", meant for the IBBS Survey. The Principal Investigator is Dr. Akhil Dhanesh Goel, Additional Professor, Department of Community Medicine and Family Medicine, AIIMS Jodhpur. The notice is dated 5 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice gives two alternative essential qualifications for the Research Assistant post: Master's in public health, Sociology, Social work, Anthropology, Microbiology, Zoology or Health Science, or equivalent. OR Graduate in Science, Sociology, Social work, Anthropology, Microbiology, Zoology or Health Science, or equivalent, from a recognized University, with three years of work experience from a recognized institution. Desirable qualifications and skills, as printed: Experience in the field of HIV/AIDS. Exposure in field-based health survey. Experience in working with High Risk groups like FSW, MSM, IDU and H/TG. Good computer knowledge. Fluency in local regional language. Good English language skills. Good people interaction and communication skills. Willing to travel at frequent interval.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The emolument is Rs. 31,000/- per month, fixed and consolidated. The notice says the salary is a consolidated sum without any other benefits and is based on the experience, qualifications and skill set of the candidate. The tenure of the post is up to 31.03.2027. The post is purely temporary/contractual for the specified period, based on the project and co-terminus with it.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Research Assistant Job Description
content_sections.text: Coordination of project activities (meetings, trainings, data collection and other field work) under the supervision of the Project Coordinator/PI. Coordination with concerned authorities at state level. Comprehensive planning, implementation and timely completion of fieldwork, which includes visiting hot spots and conducting interviews of the HRG group, FGDs and KII. Any other duties that may be assigned by the nodal officer from time to time. Survey sites will be in any district of Rajasthan, so the selected candidate would be posted accordingly.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Jodhpur Research Assistant
content_sections.text: The notice states that no enquiries will be entertained after the due date. The notice does not name a subject line for the email.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The interview will be conducted online. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for the online interview, which is on 16 November 2026 (Monday). The link for the online interview will be shared shortly, and the notice does not print the interview time. The selected candidate has to come to AIIMS Jodhpur for physical document verification.
